model_answer:
## Spirit Airlines (NYSE: SAVE) — FY 2024 Operating KPIs

Source: FY2024 Form 10-K (filed March 3, 2025), MD&A "Comparative Operating Statistics (unaudited)" table. Spirit's KPI set is 16 metrics: 7 traffic/capacity/fleet, 5 unit revenue & unit cost, 2 fuel, and 2 per-segment/pricing measures.

| # | KPI | FY 2024 | FY 2023 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Average aircraft | 209.9 | 199.5 | +5.2% |
| 2 | Aircraft at end of period | 213 | 205 | +3.9% |
| 3 | Average daily aircraft utilization (hours) | 9.9 | 11.1 | (10.8)% |
| 4 | Departures | 288,180 | 297,900 | (3.3)% |
| 5 | Passenger flight segments (PFSs, thousands) | 44,180 | 44,105 | +0.2% |
| 6 | Revenue passenger miles (RPMs, thousands) | 43,671,009 | 45,243,787 | (3.5)% |
| 7 | Available seat miles (ASMs, thousands) | 53,017,948 | 55,665,561 | (4.8)% |
| 8 | Load factor | 82.4% | 81.3% | +1.1 pts |
| 9 | Total revenue per passenger flight segment | $111.21 | $121.58 | (8.5)% |
| 10 | Average yield | 11.25¢ | 11.85¢ | (5.1)% |
| 11 | TRASM (total revenue per ASM) | 9.27¢ | 9.63¢ | (3.7)% |
| 12 | CASM | 11.35¢ | 10.52¢ | +7.9% |
| 13 | Adjusted CASM | 10.76¢ | 10.33¢ | +4.2% |
| 14 | Adjusted CASM ex‑fuel | 7.97¢ | 7.06¢ | +12.9% |
| 15 | Fuel gallons consumed (thousands) | 551,819 | 591,796 | (6.8)% |
| 16 | Average fuel cost per gallon | $2.68 | $3.08 | (13.0)% |

Notes:
- Aircraft at end of period includes 21 aircraft classified as assets held for sale at 12/31/2024.
- Adjusted CASM excludes loss on disposal of assets, special charges (credits), furlough-related items and litigation loss contingency adjustments; Adjusted CASM ex‑fuel further excludes aircraft fuel and related taxes.
- The KPI table's identity checks: load factor = RPMs/ASMs (43,671,009/53,017,948 = 82.4%); TRASM = $4,913.4M revenue / 53,017,948 thousand ASMs = 9.27¢; operating margin was –22.5% on $4,913.4M of operating revenue.
- Context figures disclosed alongside (not in the KPI table): 213 Airbus A320-family aircraft (2 A319ceo, 63 A320ceo, 91 A320neo, 29 A321ceo, 28 A321neo), average fleet age ≈5.8 years, 87 destinations in 15 countries.
- "Average stage length" (≈988 miles for 1H24 in the quarterly releases) was **not** carried in the FY2024 10-K's comparative operating statistics table — the table instead added "Average aircraft."
judge_reason: All 16 FY2024 Operating KPI values match the official rubric, with equivalent unit and scale restatements.
